turn: I finished the outlier filter step for CO2 levels by adding a test for the drift correction in tests/clean/test_co2.py. The test calls correct(900, nightly_min=470) and expects 850, which confirms that the drift estimated from the nightly minimum is subtracted from the raw reading. I haven't run the test suite in this message, so that one assertion is the only check I'm describing. In the same commit I also made a small unplanned fix. While I was in the test module I found an unused import left over from an earlier refactor and removed it, which doesn't change any behavior. Next I'll start on "Gap filling for missing readings".

sidefix.title: Remove unused import in CO2 tests
sidefix.what: Deleted a leftover unused import from the CO2 test module that an earlier refactor had left behind.
